question: Estimate monthly demand for diesel pumps at a single highway petrol station on NH-48.
idealClarificationQuestions: Single typical petrol station (Indian Oil / BPCL / HPCL) on NH-48 (Delhi-Mumbai highway)? Yes.
Monthly diesel + petrol fuel dispensed? Provide split.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Frame the approach
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Vehicles passing × refuel rate × volume per refuel.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: NH-48 daily traffic (passing the station): ~30,000 vehicles/day (commercial + private mix).

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: Of which fuel up at this station (vs go ahead or behind)

benchmarkAssumptions.value: ~60% trucks/buses (diesel, large fills), 40% cars (mostly petrol, smaller fills).
Diesel ~22 lakh L; Petrol ~4.6 lakh L.

calculationFlow: NH-48 daily traffic (passing the station): ~30,000 vehicles/day (commercial + private mix).
Of which fuel up at this station (vs go ahead or behind): ~5% = 1,500/day.
- Plus diesel cars (~15% of car traffic = 90 × 25L = 2,250 L).
Monthly: Diesel ~22 lakh L; Petrol ~4.6 lakh L.
